done_when: The worker brief and the shipped test standards carry a short Windows checklist: a path written into a file or compared as text goes through json.dumps or as_posix; tests never assume a drive letter or a '/' separator; file operations in tests use the repo's lock-safe helpers where it has them. New and existing repos: every repo gets it from the new release's brief and on its next forge sync; nothing in forge.toml changes. One test checks the synced brief and standards carry the checklist.
why: Workers build on macOS or Linux, so Windows-only mistakes (a path written into a TOML or JSON file without escaping its backslashes, a test assuming a drive or a '/' separator) surface only in CI, each costing a full extra round
